chapter: Coleman Hawkins, Bernie Young and doubling on tenor
title: Buying a first saxophone and leaving it with Johnny Dodds
summary: Clarinet devotees disliked the saxophone; he left his first alto with Johnny Dodds before leaving Chicago for New York.
